prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-realistic close-up of a stunning rose crafted entirely from faceted crystal and glass, its petals shimmering with intricate reflections and refracted light. The central rose is a deep, translucent pink, with each petal edged in sparkling highlights, giving the flower a jewel-like, ethereal quality. Surrounding the main crystal rose are softly blurred, natural pink roses, their delicate petals and green leaves providing a gentle contrast to the sharp, prismatic surfaces of the central bloom. The background is dark and out of focus, creating a dramatic, high-contrast setting that accentuates the luminous, almost magical glow of the crystal rose. The lighting is soft yet focused, with pinpoint highlights that enhance the sense of depth and three-dimensionality. The overall style is elegant and fantastical, reminiscent of fine art photography or a cinematic close-up, with a shallow depth of field that draws all attention to the exquisite details of the glass rose.
